ksiImplementation: ACME Identity Service disables accounts when automated risk scoring identifies significant account compromise risk.
ksiValidation: ACME.IAM.2.1v1: Accounts with critical user-risk signals SHALL be blocked from interactive access. Blocking high-risk account sessions reduces the chance that compromised credentials can access the service.
ACME.IAM.2.3v1: Sign-ins with critical risk signals SHALL be blocked before session establishment. This prevents high-risk authentication events from establishing a service session.
ksiAssessment: ACME.IAM.2.1v1: Critical-Risk Accounts Blocked: An automated account-risk policy blocking critical-risk accounts is present and enabled. Status: satisfied.
ACME.IAM.2.3v1: Critical-Risk Sign-ins Blocked: Assessment of ACME.IAM.2.3v1: sign-ins with critical risk signals are blocked. Status: satisfied.

Observation: ACME.IAM.2.1v1 - Critical-Risk Accounts Blocked: Examiner confirmed through a read-only ACME Identity Service configuration query that an account-risk policy with critical-risk matching and a block action is present and enabled.

Observation: ACME.IAM.2.3v1 - Critical-Risk Sign-ins Blocked: Examiner confirmed through a read-only ACME Identity Service configuration query that sign-ins with critical risk signals are blocked before session establishment.
